row.team_price_text: Request pricing (no public prices; usage-based, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Qualtrics documents no SCIM endpoint; its SSO guide says Qualtrics can create user accounts when users successfully authenticate (just-in-time provisioning), and Microsoft's Entra tutorial lists only SSO with just-in-time provisioning.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: the pricing page sells the XM platform by product with 'Request pricing' only, based on planned usage with an unlimited number of users. SSO (SAML, LDAP, CAS, Google OAuth) is a paid feature checked with the Account Executive. No SCIM endpoint appears in the support centre sitemap, the SSO guides or the API reference (Stoplight project list), so status is none by absence; the only automation is SSO just-in-time provisioning with User Type, Division and Group mapping from SSO attributes (fallbacks.jit). The REST API v3 has full Users (CRUD, accountStatus active/disabled), Groups, Divisions and Audits (activity logs) endpoints, but the API is a purchased feature ('Once you've purchased the Qualtrics API feature'), so api_tax is true. Okta OIN app is SAML/SWA only; Entra gallery app is SSO with JIT.

plans.name: Qualtrics XM Platform (CX, EX, digital and other product packages)
plans.notes: Unlimited users in every product; priced on planned usage. SSO and API are separately purchased features.

scim.notes: available=false is by absence: SCIM is never mentioned on the SSO, user-management or API pages; user automation is SSO JIT only.

auth.notes: X-API-TOKEN header or OAuth 2.0 client credentials; user calls require a brand administrator.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via PUT /users/{userId} with status active/disabled; roles are User Types (userType) and per-user permissions.

limitations.text: User calls require a Qualtrics brand administrator.

okta.notes: OIN functionality ticked: SAML and SWA only (last updated Sep. 28 2026).

entra.notes: Gallery app supports SP- and IdP-initiated SSO with just-in-time user creation; no automatic provisioning.

fallbacks.other_sync: SSO attribute mapping on each login (User Type, Division, Groups); LDAP and CAS SSO also supported
fallbacks.notes: JIT also works for LDAP, CAS and Google OAuth SSO types per the SSO guides; jit_protocol records SAML, the IdP-catalogue case.

citations.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) | Qualtrics Support
citations.quote: Attention: SSO is a paid feature. If you are a Brand Administrator, check with your Qualtrics Account Executive to see if SSO is available for your license.

citations.title: Managing Users & Brands with SSO | Qualtrics Support
citations.quote: Qualtrics has the ability to create user accounts when users successfully authenticate, but do not yet have an account in your Qualtrics brand.

citations.title: Managing Users & Brands with SSO | Qualtrics Support
citations.quote: Attention: When Just-in-Time-User-Provisioning is disabled for a brand, user accounts must be manually created in Qualtrics by Brand Administrators.

citations.title: Managing Users & Brands with SSO | Qualtrics Support
citations.quote: Unlike mapping User Types and Divisions, mapping Groups will not overwrite changes made by Brand Administrators to users’ Groups, since users can be part of multiple Groups at one time.

citations.title: SSO Technical Requirements | Qualtrics Support
citations.quote: Qualtrics supports four types of SSO authentication: Google OAuth 2.0, Central Authentication Service (CAS), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), and Security Assertion Markup

citations.title: API Overview | Qualtrics Support

citations.title: Users API (Qualtrics API reference, OpenAPI)

citations.title: Groups API (Qualtrics API reference, OpenAPI)

citations.title: Audits API (Qualtrics API reference, OpenAPI)

citations.quote: Qualtrics supports just-in-time user provisioning, which is enabled by default. There's no additional action for you to take. If a user doesn't already exist in Qualtrics, a new one is created after authentication.
